t0384-01.gloss: A personal field trace precedes the visible emergency response.
t0384-01.rival_reading: Responders could have collected the brown foam while crossing treated land; the note or objects do not prove the program began the emergency.

t0384-02.gloss: Campers knew which roads would close before it was announced.
t0384-02.rival_reading: Campers could mark closed roads after hearing a bulletin about crop spraying; the map does not show who closed them.
